scope.register: Scholastic formal equivalence and source wording as supplied

findings.current_english_substring: said that there was already a counsel and stratagem, and this soul could descend.
findings.replacement_substring: said that there is already a counsel and stratagem, and this soul can descend.
findings.rationale: The direct-report forms יש and יכולה are present-tense (“there is” and “can”), so the draft’s backshift to “was/could” unnecessarily changes the source’s tense and immediacy.

findings.current_english_substring: then she will strengthen and be healed
findings.replacement_substring: then she will grow strong and be healed
findings.rationale: The intransitive תתחזק means that she will become or grow strong, whereas uncomplemented “will strengthen” is needlessly liable to be read transitively in this formal register.

findings.current_english_substring: then he will immediately settle his mind, look closely at himself, and have very great compassion upon himself:
findings.replacement_substring: then he will immediately settle his mind, consider, and have very great compassion upon himself:
findings.rationale: In ויסתכל וירחם על עצמו, על עצמו governs “have compassion” rather than “look,” while what he is to consider is supplied by the following paragraph’s “Where is he in the world?”
